elements_selected.content: Add a `reason` feature flag to Cargo.toml. Under this feature, add spindle-core and spindle-parser as optional Cargo dependencies. Add a `reason` module to src/lib.rs gated behind #[cfg(feature = "reason")]. Ensure `cargo check` passes both with and without the feature. This follows ADR-005: embed spindle-core as a Rust library dependency behind a feature flag.
